chunks: And he asked him about a man: is it proper for him to perform salat (prayer) upon fresh growing vegetation?
He said: “If he places his forehead firmly on the ground, then there is no harm.”

key_terms.النَّابِتَةِ: that which is growing from the ground
key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or objection

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) on fresh growing vegetation if the forehead touches the ground?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about performing salat (prayer) in a place where there is fresh growing vegetation. The ruling indicates permissibility so long as the forehead is placed on the ground, highlighting the importance of proper sajdah contact with the earth.
